answer: Investment-grade and high-yield are categories of corporate bonds distinguished by credit rating and credit risk. Investment-grade bonds have higher credit ratings and less credit risk than high-yield bonds. High-yield bonds have lower credit ratings and higher credit risk, and offer higher interest rates in return for that increased risk.
